title: Integrated Network Pharmacology and Experimental Approach to Investigate the Protective Effect of Jin Gu Lian Capsule on Rheumatoid Arthritis by Inhibiting Inflammation via IL-17/NF-kappaB Pathway.
authors: Chen, Tengfei; Li, Sihan; Lian, Dongyin; Hu, Qin; Hou, Hongping; Niu, Delian; Li, Han; Song, Ling; Gao, Yunhang; Chen, Ying; Hu, Xiaoru; Li, Jianrong; Ye, Zuguang; Peng, Bo; Zhang, Guangping
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究金骨莲胶囊抗类风湿关节炎的IL-17/NF-κB通路，虽含分子对接但对象为化合物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: PURPOSE: This study aimed to investigate the main pharmacological action and underlying mechanisms of Jin Gu Lian Capsule (JGL) against rheumatoid arthritis (RA) based on network pharmacology and experimental verification. METHODS: Network pharmacology approaches were performed to explore the core active compounds of JGL, key therapeutic targets, and signaling pathways. Molecular docking was used to predict the binding affinity of compounds with targets. In vivo experiments were undertaken to validate the findings from network analysis. RESULTS: A total of 52 targets were identified as candidate JGL targets for RA. Sixteen ingredients were identified as the core active compounds, including, quercetin, myricetin, salidroside, etc. Interleukin-1 beta (IL1B), transcription factor AP-1 (JUN), growth-regulated alpha protein (CXCL1), C-X-C motif chemokine (CXCL)3, CXCL2, signal transducer and activator of transcription 1 (STAT1), prostaglandin G/H synthase 2 (PTGS2), matrix metalloproteinase (MMP)1, inhibitor of nuclear factor kappa-B kinase subunit beta (IKBKB) and transcription factor p65 (RELA) were obtained as the key therapeutic targets. Gene Ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes pathway enrichment analysis showed that the efficacy of JGL was functionally involved in regulating immune-mediated inflammation, in which IL-17/NF-kappaB signaling was recommended as one of the main pathways. Molecular docking suggested that the core active compounds bound strongly to their respective targets. Experimentally, JGL treatment mitigated inflammation, showed analgesic activity, and ameliorated collagen-induced arthritis. Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay showed that JGL effectively reduced the serum levels of cytokines, chemokines, and MMPs. Immunohistochemistry staining showed that JGL markedly reduced the expression of the targets in IL-17/NF-kappaB pathway including IL-17A, IL-17RA, NF-kappaB p65, C-X-C motif ligand 2, MMP1 and MMP13. CONCLUSION: This investigation provided evidence that JGL may alleviate RA symptoms by partially inhibiting the immune-mediated inflammation via IL-17/NF-kappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在基于网络药理学和实验验证，探讨金骨莲胶囊（JGL）对抗类风湿关节炎（RA）的主要药理作用及其潜在机制。方法：采用网络药理学方法探索JGL的核心活性化合物、关键治疗靶点及信号通路。利用分子对接预测化合物与靶点的结合亲和力。进行体内实验以验证网络分析的结果。结果：共鉴定出52个靶点作为JGL治疗RA的候选靶点。十六种成分被确定为核心活性化合物，包括槲皮素、杨梅素、红景天苷等。白细胞介素-1β（IL1B）、转录因子AP-1（JUN）、生长调节α蛋白（CXCL1）、C-X-C基序趋化因子（CXCL）3、CXCL2、信号转导与转录激活因子1（STAT1）、前列腺素G/H合酶2（PTGS2）、基质金属蛋白酶（MMP）1、核因子κB激酶亚基β抑制剂（IKBKB）和转录因子p65（RELA）被确定为关键治疗靶点。基因本体论和京都基因与基因组百科全书通路富集分析显示，JGL的药效在功能上涉及调节免疫介导的炎症，其中IL-17/NF-κB信号通路被推荐为主要通路之一。分子对接表明，核心活性化合物与其各自靶点结合紧密。实验上，JGL治疗减轻了炎症，表现出镇痛活性，并改善了胶原诱导的关节炎。酶联免疫吸附试验显示，JGL有效降低了血清中细胞因子、趋化因子和MMP的水平。免疫组织化学染色显示，JGL显著降低了IL-17/NF-κB通路中靶点（包括IL-17A、IL-17RA、NF-κB p65、C-X-C基序配体2、MMP1和MMP13）的表达。结论：本研究提供证据表明，JGL可能通过部分抑制IL-17/NF-κB通路介导的免疫炎症来缓解RA症状。
